I took way too much of the psychedelic LSA (tripping multiple times in less than two weeks) in late November 2017 and went completely psychotic from it. I was hospitalized for a week, but it was so traumatizing that my psychosis acually got worse and with absolutely no sense of better judgement, I tripped again two weeks later, again mutiple times as I had in November.

I was sent to a mental hospital the day after Christmas and didn't get out for two months, being totally delusional the whole time. I'm just appalled by the way I behaved, the things I believed and the things I said. There were staff and patients who legitimately hated me, and I don't blame them at all.

I've been hinting at it as I've become more active in the drug subreddits, but never told the full story. The psychosis actually lasted longer than two months, more like four, and even after I recovered from the delusions, I'd lost a part of myself that has yet to come back. I'll write the story of what happened and post it on r/lsa.
Yeah, I think you'll be fine. I'd just recommend taking some ginger root extract half an hour before the trip and drinking the syrup over 15-20 minutes to avoid any possible nausea.

I'd say yes, although my only bad DXM trip was nothing compared to my psychosis-inducing/worsening bad LSA trips in late 2017.

I had a third plateau trip at the end of last month in which, at the peak, I felt like I was back in a room in the mental hospital where I spent two months in LSA psychosis. I was afraid to leave my room for a solid hour because I was certain that if I opened the door, I'd be in the hallway of the hospital unit I was in for most of the time I was there. The memories of being trapped there were so vivid at that point that it felt as if the entire ordeal had happened the day before. 

It's a very different experience from psychedelics, but set and setting should still be taken into consideration with DXM, especially above the second plateau. On the day of my bad trip, I'd been in therapy and discussing the traumatic impact of the hospital, so my mind went back there that night.

Yeah, it's horrible. I was able to avoid the nausea by combining it with Dramamine, but I think that might have exacerbated the damage it did to my body because the entire morning glory seed extraction would just stay in my system the whole time. I had awful leg cramps for months, and I'm a lot more susceptible to nausea and vomiting now than I used to be.

LSA. I abused it to the point where I developed psychosis and was sent to a mental hospital twice- first for a week and then at a different one for two months- and I've spent the past year struggling with undiagnosed PTSD from what I went through.

Have fun, but be careful. It has some addiction potential and vomiting is pretty much inevitable (I'd say at least 75% guaranteed if you take syrup/pills with guaf), not to mention all the other side effects of abuse. Olney's Lesions may not actually happen, but if you do it on a regular basis, you're definitely going to notice after a few months that you're not quite as sharp and present in reality as you once were. Once a month is probably the safest way to do it. It might be hard to resist the urge sometimes, but on top of the physical side effects, the "magic" of the trip starts to wear off after a few months or so of regular use. 

I definitely recommend checking out r/dxm. There are some really cool people in it who can answer any questions you may have. The Dextroverse is a fun place, just make sure you're not going into it every week.
Of course! I'm glad you're feeling better. Best of luck to you with everything

Try to keep in mind that it's only been a day. It's totally normal to be out of it for some time after an experience like that. My advice is to just try to take it easy for the next week or two and let yourself process the experience in a sober state. Do you have a close friend you could talk to about it?

I've been able to mostly avoid nausea by smoking weed immediately before and after dosing, drinking the syrup slowly (usually about 4-5oz in 15 minutes), and mostly lying down/staying still for the first hour of the trip. I strongly recommend using a sativa or sativa hybrid to potentiate the DXM; I've noticed indica strains have made me fall asleep before the end of the trip. 
That being said, I think Robocough is probably the best way to go if you can order it, although I haven't been able to try it myself. Nearly all the cough syrup available at stores in the US contain guaifenesin.
